Contact

Contact Us

This website is an educational resource, not a clinic. Use this page for corrections, source suggestions or general questions about the content.

Home/Contact

This website does not provide treatment, consultations or diagnoses, and no clinician is available through it. Please read the notes below before writing to us.

What to contact us about

Appropriate and inappropriate enquiries

Content corrections & sources

Spotted an error, a broken link or a source we should include? We welcome evidence-based corrections and suggestions.

General questions about the content

Questions about how a page explains a concept, or where a cited source comes from, are welcome.

Medical advice — not here

We cannot give personal medical advice, diagnose a condition or recommend a treatment. Please see a qualified, registered clinician.

Urgent symptoms — seek care now

If you have fever, spreading redness, a new lump, chest pain or any urgent symptom after a procedure, contact a clinician or emergency services immediately.

Message form

Send a general message

This form collects only what is needed to reply. Please do not send detailed medical history, symptoms, test results or images. We cannot respond to individual medical questions.

  • We reply by email only.
  • We cannot provide medical advice or diagnosis.
  • Please do not include personal medical details.
  • Messages are handled confidentially.
Your information is handled confidentially.

This is not a clinic

No doctor, clinic, medical team or physical address is presented on this website because none has been verified. Submitting a message does not create a doctor–patient relationship and does not commit you to any treatment.

Prefer to email us directly?

Write to enquiries@nonsurgicalbreastenlargement.in. This is the only contact channel published on this website.
